verdict.rationale: A public GitHub repo exists (xai-org/grok-build), and several independent community reports describe the code as open-sourced. Users report reviewing about 1.3M lines of Rust, note the source release makes reverse engineering easier, and say forks such as a privacy fork and multi-provider CLIs appeared soon after. Issues and Discussions being disabled limits community engagement but not the ability to read the source. Missing for 10: the specific license is never named, and no first-party documentation states the licensing terms.
